subject.title: feat: rediseñar formulario de creación de cupones en admin

question: Should the coupon redesign add a separate customer-visible coupon text field, or keep the existing single description field while only reorganizing the admin UI?
rationale: Current code stores one required description and checkout displays that same value, so splitting internal and customer copy changes persisted data and storefront behavior.

options.title: Split description fields
options.body: Add explicit internal and customer-visible fields and update admin APIs, coupon schema/repository, and checkout display behavior in the same delivery.

options.title: UI-only redesign
options.body: Keep the current description contract and implement the guided modal, preview, and duplicate-prefill flow without changing coupon data semantics.

recommendation.title: Split description fields
recommendation.body: Add explicit internal and customer-visible fields and update admin APIs, coupon schema/repository, and checkout display behavior in the same delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent coupon panel revamp and opened this follow-up with the mockup and acceptance criteria.
